name: Track The Human Optic RAdiation (THORA): Contrack - Tracking Eccentricity
summary: Tracks the optic radiation from LGN to V1 with ConTrack probabilistic tractography and splits it into bundles by visual-field eccentricity from pRF maps.
description: Builds LGN and eccentricity-binned V1 ROIs (from pRF eccentricity masked to V1 and the FreeSurfer ribbon), runs ConTrack between them in each hemisphere, and prunes streamlines with anatomical planes around the LGN, hemisphere, CSF and exclusion ROIs. Needs a dtiinit, a T1, ROIs containing LGN and V1 (and optionally exclusion ROIs), pRF eccentricity, a 5TT mask and FreeSurfer; expect up to 32 hours. Use the visual white matter App to track between other ROI pairs.

inputs.description: dtiinit output (vistasoft) providing the diffusion data and tensor fit used by ConTrack.
T1-weighted image that defines the working space; ROIs, eccentricity, ribbons and CSF are resampled to it.
must include thalamic rois 008109 and 008209 derived from app-segment-thalamic-nuclei
inputs.requirements: Must contain lh/rh LGN and V1 ROIs named *<hemi>.<lgn>.nii.gz and *<hemi>.<v1>.nii.gz (names set by the lgn and v1 parameters); optional *<hemi>.exclusion.nii.gz.

inputs.description: Population receptive field (pRF) maps; the eccentricity map is used to split visual cortex into eccentricity bins.
MRtrix3 five-tissue-type (5TT) mask; its CSF volume is used as an exclusion region.
FreeSurfer subject directory; the cortical ribbon (ribbon.mgz, lh/rh.ribbon.mgz) restricts eccentricity to cortex and defines hemisphere exclusions.

outputs.description: Tractogram (.tck) of the pruned optic radiation streamlines from all eccentricity bins and both hemispheres.
White matter classification assigning streamlines to optic radiation bundles per hemisphere and eccentricity bin, with tract JSONs for visualisation and fiber counts.

parameters.description: Number of streamlines desired. NOTE: This may not be final total as tracking is performed without anatomical constraints (i.e. csf exclusion)
Maximum number of nodes (points) per ConTrack streamline.
Minimum number of nodes (points) per ConTrack streamline.
Number of top-scoring streamlines for a contrack_score selection step; that step is commented out in this branch, so the value is not used.
Name of the LGN ROI in the rois input; files matching *lh.<lgn>.nii.gz and *rh.<lgn>.nii.gz are used.
Name of the V1 ROI in the rois input; files matching *lh.<v1>.nii.gz and *rh.<v1>.nii.gz are used.
Space-separated lower bounds (degrees of visual angle) of the eccentricity bins; paired with maxDegree.
Space-separated upper bounds (degrees of visual angle) of the eccentricity bins; paired with minDegree.
Inflation applied to the LGN ROI before tracking (1 = no inflation).
Inflation applied to the V1 and eccentricity ROIs before tracking (1 = no inflation).
Distance threshold for an ROI-exclusion cleaning step; that step is commented out in this branch, so the value is not used.

failure_modes.fix: Check the ROI names (lgn, v1) match files in the rois input and inspect the logs.
